body.statement: For the full scores from def:full-score-covariance, including the harmonic translation score and the covariance between the leading and generated-target responses within each control cell, \(\sup_{P\in\mathcal F_s}\lVert\Sigma_{h_n}(P)-V(P)\rVert_{\mathrm{op}}\to0\), where \(V(P)=\operatorname{diag}(V_1,\ldots,V_J)\), \(V_j=w_j\sqrt{\det H(y_j)}H(y_j)/(4\pi f_{T1}(y_j))\), and \(w_j=\alpha(y_j)(\rho_{C0}^{-1}+\rho_{C1}^{-1})+\rho_{T0}^{-1}+\rho_{T1}^{-1}\). The normalized harmonic variance and every Green--harmonic cross-covariance vanish by the uniform \(L^2\) bound in thm:nested-derivative.
body.justification: The four-cell weights and angular matrix are conditionally derived from local intensities, while the uniform exact-score replacement remains open.
body.gap: The missing comparison includes generated-target cross terms, harmonic scores, transformed kernels, and moving poles.
body.consumer: It is still the candidate variance target, not an established covariance limit.

obligation.what_is_open: Show that the exact corrected four-cell scores may be replaced uniformly, after logarithmic normalization, by their frozen-pole leading Green responses.
obligation.obstruction: The algebraic intensity calculation fixes the candidate blocks, but the required uniform score comparison depends on the unresolved coupled harmonic Riesz bounds and moving-pole transformed-kernel estimates.
obligation.attempted: The four local noise intensities, coefficient matrix identity, angular constant, and separated-grid order were computed without dropping within-cell generated-target cross terms.
obligation.partial_result:
Conditionally on a valid coupled derivative and the uniform energy-parametrix bounds, the logarithmic coefficient is forced algebraically.  The frozen fundamental solution for \(-\operatorname{div}(B(y_j)\nabla\cdot)\) satisfies
\[
 \int_{h<\lvert z-y_j\rvert<r_0}
 \nabla\Gamma_{B(y_j)}(z-y_j)
 \nabla\Gamma_{B(y_j)}(z-y_j)^{\mathsf T}\,dz
 =\frac{B(y_j)^{-1}}{4\pi\sqrt{\det B(y_j)}}\log(1/h)+O(1).
\tag{10}
\]
At the pole, each treated-cell transformed noise has intensity \(f_{T1}(y_j)\).  Each control-cell transformed noise has intensity
\[
 f_{C0}(R_0(y_j))\det D(y_j)
 =\frac{f_{T1}(y_j)}{\alpha(y_j)},
\]
and its leading coefficient is \(\alpha(y_j)\); hence its variance intensity is \(\alpha(y_j)f_{T1}(y_j)\).  Since \(B=f_{T1}H^{-1}\), multiplying (10) by these intensities and the four sample-size factors gives
\[
 V_j=\left\{\alpha(y_j)(\rho_{C0}^{-1}+\rho_{C1}^{-1})
 +\rho_{T0}^{-1}+\rho_{T1}^{-1}\right\}
 \frac{\sqrt{\det H(y_j)}H(y_j)}{4\pi f_{T1}(y_j)}.
\tag{11}
\]
Independence adds the four cell covariances, while separated poles make off-diagonal grid blocks only \(O(1)\) before division by \(\log(1/h)\).  Formula (11) is therefore the only possible limiting block.  The unresolved step is the uniform replacement of the complete coupled scores by these frozen responses, including their within-control-cell cross terms.
